SIGNALS.name: *Walter Bloomberg
SIGNALS.summary: Reported: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang says the company will announce $2 billion in new European AI investments next week, on top of $8 billion invested over the past year.

SIGNALS.name: Google
SIGNALS.summary: Gemini 4 Argon is available to AI Ultra and Pro subscribers in the Gemini app and AI Mode in Search, and to developers and enterprises through the Gemini API, with an introductory price.

SIGNALS.name: Google DeepMind
SIGNALS.summary: Google DeepMind says Gemini 4 Argon is now globally available, aimed at hard problems across coding, enterprise workflows and cyber defense.

SIGNALS.name: Logan Kilpatrick
SIGNALS.summary: Logan Kilpatrick says Gemini 4 Argon is rolling out globally in the Gemini API, to Pro and Ultra in the Gemini app, and to Ultra subscribers in Antigravity; over 100,000 Googlers tested it.

SIGNALS.name: Artificial Analysis
SIGNALS.summary: Artificial Analysis scores Muse Wonder 52 and Muse Wonder Full 56 on its Intelligence Index v4.3 at max effort, up from 48 for Muse Spark 1.3, released six weeks earlier.

SIGNALS.name: Meta for Developers
SIGNALS.summary: Muse Wonder is live in Muse Code and the Meta Model API, while Muse Wonder Full launches only for Muse Code subscribers. It combines coding, long-running agents and computer use.

SIGNALS.name: AI at Meta
SIGNALS.summary: Meta introduces Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, its most capable models yet, aimed at personal and professional agentic tasks; Muse Wonder is available now through the Meta Model API.

SIGNALS.name: DoT India
SIGNALS.summary: India's Department of Telecommunications says ITU's AI for Good initiative will be inaugurated in New Delhi on 9 October as part of IMC 2026.
